name: Jesus Simulator
description:
Step into one of the most powerful stories ever told — the life of Jesus Christ. Jesus Simulator is a narrative-driven experience that brings the events of the Gospel to life with care, authenticity, and respect. Inspired by biblical texts and historically grounded sources, the game invites players to follow Jesus’ journey from His early years through His ministry, teachings, miracles, and ultimate sacrifice.

Experience a story shaped by faith, compassion, and choice as you interact with disciples, witness iconic moments, and explore meaningful encounters that have inspired generations. Through immersive storytelling and interactive elements, players discover the timeless values of love, mercy, forgiveness, and devotion.

Features:
• Immersive narrative experience presented in a visual novel style with interactive gameplay elements
• Play from multiple perspectives, including Mary, Joseph, Jesus, and His disciples
• Relive key Gospel events and miracles, recreated with respect and symbolic depth
• Explore historically inspired locations reflecting the world of the New Testament
• Thoughtful and respectful artistic direction designed to be accessible to all players

Jesus Simulator offers more than entertainment — it is a reflective journey through one of history’s most influential stories.

Live the story. Experience the message. Discover its meaning.
